title: Warn when unknown option used anywhere in the API
body:
We currently do not warn on unknown option when used in a widget, could be cool. It saves time when debugging.

First steps for this issue would be to identify and list the possible cases where warning would really help our users. For example: "Creating a menu while the facet is not an attribute for faceting"

comments.body:
It is possible to create a key that is able to only get the settings. But that requires to have a new custom key generated by the user... Would also require to have the plumbing to create the first query to check the configuration.

Maybe that could be a dev tool? Offline check before the production?

I think I mainly see it used like `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production")`.
That way if production is mistyped, you get the errors ;) (I suppose there are other reasons as well)

When a parameter is not recognized, it returns an error and this pretty fast to see with the initial search. For the parameters that are not throwing an error, we only have the facets as a use but we didn't have much problems so far with that. Let's close this issue for now and revisit if we get a brilliant idea or if we identify a pain.
